values.note: One rate for everyone (no city-resident rate): 20-amp electric-only $30 a day, 30/50-amp electric-only $32, full hookup (30/50-amp) $45; tent sites $25. Weekly $185-275, monthly $480-675 (30+ nights), seasonal $2,000-2,500. Hunters welcome after October (prices on request).

note: City of Crystal Falls park on Runkle Lake, run by a private concessionaire (Runkle Lake Camping; still city-owned), walking distance from downtown. ~33 sites (1-17 full hookup, 18-33 water/electric) plus primitive tent sites. Sandy beach, boat launch, fishing pier, lakeside playground; next to the city sports complex, with Iron Belle Trail access, and ATVs/ORVs may use Iron County roads. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's 2026 site: $30 (20-amp electric) to $45 (full hookup), 30/50-amp, water and sewer, showers, potable water, dump, Firefly booking. The concessionaire is still 'Runkle Lake Camping' (contact lynn@runklelakecamping.com, 920-265-1425 or 920-265-0656), and the City of Crystal Falls' own site sends campers there; the 920 number is the operator's published one (also on Google Maps: 'Runkle Lake Camping', 4.8 stars / 32 reviews). Added Wi-Fi, booking link and notes. Season left as recorded (the site gives no dates; it welcomes hunters after October). Note: dropped amperage, season and booking text.
flags: Firefly's equipment list offers Fifth Wheel, Popup, Tent, Travel Trailer and Truck Camper but no motorhome type; the operator's home page speaks of 'putting down the automatic jacks on our full hook-up sites', so it looks like an engine setup gap, but a 23-ft Class C may need to book by phone (920-265-1425).
Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator advertises 'lakeside camping' at Runkle Lake with a beach and pier; the entry is 'not waterfront'.
